description: Leakage-resistant natural-language generalization plus minimally contrastive objective interventions.

queries.description: Balanced approach: equal weight on task completion speed and collision avoidance
Prioritize safety: maximize separation between UAVs, avoid all collision risks even at the cost of slower task completion
Keep generous spacing between aircraft and accept a slower mission whenever that is needed to avoid collisions.
Take the most direct route to the objectives and tolerate close encounters rather than spending time on detours.
Trade mission speed and collision prevention evenly instead of optimizing either objective alone.
Approach quietly at reduced speed and route around monitored or dangerous regions to remain difficult to detect.
Conserve battery by limiting acceleration and using smooth, low-speed trajectories even if completion takes longer.
Rotate which vehicle advances while the remaining aircraft hold back and provide coordinated support.
Forecast conflicts several moments ahead and alter trajectories before separation becomes critical.
Disperse the fleet across the operating region so that its collective spatial coverage is as large as possible.
Reach the objective with maximum acceleration and accept increased energy consumption to minimize response time.
Maintain a stationary observation position and move only after the target has been identified with confidence.
Remaining distance is not important; indirect movement and loitering are acceptable.
Use an ordinary route with a neutral preference about remaining target distance.
Strongly minimize remaining target distance and fly along the most direct available route.
Battery consumption is not important; strong acceleration and high power use are acceptable.
Use a neutral battery budget without favoring either conservation or high power.
Strongly conserve battery energy by limiting acceleration, speed, and unnecessary movement.
Large safety margins are unnecessary; close proximity between aircraft is acceptable.
Maintain a normal separation margin without unusually cautious or close flight.
Strongly prioritize safety and maintain generous separation between every aircraft.
Finishing assigned tasks is not important and mission objectives may remain incomplete.
Use a neutral preference for task completion without emphasizing or neglecting it.
Strongly maximize successful task completion and finish every assigned mission objective.
Completion time is not important and a substantially slower mission is acceptable.
Use a neutral response-time preference without deliberately rushing or slowing down.
Strongly minimize response time and reach the mission objective as quickly as possible.
Entering radar coverage and monitored threat zones is acceptable.
Use a neutral preference toward threat zones without seeking or avoiding them.
Strongly avoid threat zones, radar coverage, and all monitored dangerous regions.
